pages.text: Create is the primary Tier 1 tech mod. Mechanical power, automated crafting, and item transport.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Your first automation engine. Brass production is the T1 ceiling material. Mixing recipes allow transmutation of T1 materials into small quantities of T2 materials at an intentionally poor ratio.$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$(/bold) Brass is a required material throughout T1. Mechanical Crafters automate token fragment collection. The Deployer can automate enchanting table interactions.

$(bold)What's gated:$(/bold) Nothing in Create is tier-gated. The entire mod is available from Tier 1.$(br2)$(bold)What's recommended:$(/bold) Build a brass auto-crafter early. Brass costs are higher than vanilla Minecraft expects them to be — plan for it.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$(/bold) Artificer's Efficient Engineering passive boosts machine speed. A T1 Artificer player can set up extremely efficient Create lines.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Create uses an in-world $(bold)Ponder$(/bold) system — hold $(bold)W$(/bold) while hovering any Create block in JEI to open an animated tutorial. It's one of the best in-game documentation systems in any mod.
